__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the InfluxDB data source that reads the solark bucket.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/New_York")

historical = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-18T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-08-16T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="solark_energy_totals" and r.source=="solarassistant_backfill" and r._field=="daily_load_kwh")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>"${inverter}"=="System")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1d,fn:max,createEmpty:false,timeSrc:"_start")
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with _field:"Load"}))

live = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 2026-08-16T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>if "${inverter}"=="System" then (r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_load_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_load_energy") else r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_load_energy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1d,fn:max,createEmpty:false,timeSrc:"_start")
  |> duplicate(column:"_time",as:"day")
  |> group(columns:["day"])
  |> sum(column:"_value")
  |> duplicate(column:"day",as:"_time")
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with _field:"Load"}))

union(tables:[historical,live])
  |> group(columns:["_field"])
  |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","_field"])
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._time >= date.sub(d:30d,from:now()))
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])
